subject: Submission window playbook: weekly forecast & pre-call runs
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 09 Sep 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Submission window playbook: weekly forecast & pre-call runs

Team —

Quick operational note for this week’s numbers cycle. Please read and action before the 12:00 PT submission window closes. I’m keeping this tight so ops can finalize and send to Finance by 13:00.

What I need from each AE/AM: - Update stage to the most accurate state (Proposal/Legal/Commit) by EOD or mark as ‘At Risk’ with a one-line reason in the deal notes. - Confirm best-case ARR and whether you are placing the opportunity in commit. If you mark commit, include any required PO/SoW dates.
- Attach the short checklist (attached) to any deals that are moving into Commit.

Pre-call: I’ll run a 20-minute pre-call at 10:30 PT to triage borderline deals and ensure documentation is in HubSpot. Karthik — can you host the pre-call and bring the Tidewater details?

Tidewater specific: Sophie from Tidewater is moving procurement forward this week but asked for a final pricing confirmation. Please flag any discounts or credits you’ve already offered in the deal notes.

Attachments: forecast_submission_checklist.xlsx (checklist), tidewater_mop_agenda.pdf (pre-call slide stub)

Deliverable timeline:
- 10:30 PT — pre-call (zoom link on the calendar)
- 12:00 PT — final stage updates & commit flags in HubSpot
- 13:00 PT — file handed to Finance

If you hit blockers (procurement, legal exceptions, or required credits) flag them in the Slack #revops-urgent channel with the tag @laura.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 09 Sep 2028 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Submission window playbook: weekly forecast & pre-call runs

Ack — thanks, Laura. I’ll have a couple of quick updates before the pre-call:
- ACME Platform (Deal ID: ACME-9001): moving from Proposal -> Commit, awaiting PO (expected this week). I attached my checklist to the deal record.
- Borealis Media (Deal ID: BORE-317): needs to be moved back to Late Negotiation — legal asked for a minor SLA change. Marking as At Risk in HubSpot with note.

Also, Tidewater — Sophie asked for a short summary of the commercial terms we’ve discussed. I’ve dropped a draft into the Drive under the weekly folder (link in the message Laura included).

On the pre-call I’ll lead ACME/Borealis. See you at 10:30.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

I’ll host the 10:30 pre-call and bring a one-slide summary for Tidewater: current ARR, expected signature window, open procurement items. Quick note on Tidewater — procurement flagged a required security attestation on data retention; security has already sent the standard attestation but procurement wants the signed copy by COB next Tuesday. That may push the recognition timing if the PO slips.

For the pre-call agenda I’ll cover:
- 1) Quick staging confirmation (2 min per deal)
- 2) Flagged blockers (legal/procurement/credit)
- 3) Commit confirmation and PO timelines (final pass)

I’ll record the call notes directly into the HubSpot deal comments and ping Finance when we close the list.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick updates — consolidated notes below and final asks before I hand to Finance. Please treat this as the single source for the week’s submission.

Final consolidated callouts:
- Commit in: ACME Platform (ACME-9001) — Marissa confirms PO expected; I’m leaving this in Commit for Finance but mark the PO expected date in HubSpot.
- Pull out: Borealis Media (BORE-317) — moved to At Risk due to SLA change; not in commit.
- Tidewater (RW-2028-TIDE-42) — keep in Upside/Close but do NOT include in commit unless procurement confirms signed attestation and PO by COB Tue. Karthik to update HubSpot the second attestation is uploaded.

Attachments (sent to Finance): forecast_submission_checklist.xlsx

Pre-call notes: agenda flowed as planned; recorded action items in HubSpot.

Next steps:
- If you changed anything after 12:00 PT, post a one-line update in #revops-urgent and tag me.
- Finance will ping if they need any backup; leave the checklist on the deal record.

Great run — appreciate the fast follow.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
